latHint: Think a tiny measure of salt - not a sprint.
pivHint: To DASH through the snow is to run fast - but a DASH of salt in a recipe is how small a measure?
winText: Just a smidge. DASH was the pivot - a sprint to a PINCH of seasoning.
lossText: PINCH - a tiny amount. DASH was the pivot: a sprint through snow to a DASH of salt.
